'''''Chambeyronia macrocarpa''''' is a species of [[palm tree]] commonly known as the '''red leaf palm'''. It is sometimes called the '''flamethrower palm'''. The species is [[endemic]] to [[New Caledonia]].<ref name=e>{{cite web|url=http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/synonomy.do?name_id=38310|title=World Checklist of Selected Plant Families: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|author=|date=|website=apps.kew.org|accessdate=25 March 2018}}</ref><ref>Govaerts, R. & Dransfield, J. (2005). World Checklist of Palms: 1-223. The Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew.</ref>
